subject.title: feat(agents): screen tool drives Control UI layout (ui.command channel)

question: Should a `screen` tool call intentionally rearrange every connected capable Control UI, or only the UI associated with the initiating web/app turn or source session?
rationale: The branch explicitly implements all-client fan-out, while the canonical feature proposal described session-scoped delivery; either behavior is technically possible, but the operator experience and targeting contract require maintainer intent.

options.title: Target the initiating UI
options.body: Carry or derive a trusted initiating-client target and deliver the command only to that capable Control UI, with a defined session-scoped fallback.

options.title: Synchronize all capable UIs
options.body: Keep fan-out to every capable Control UI and document that one agent command intentionally changes all connected operator layouts.

options.title: Pause until targeting exists
options.body: Defer this phase until the gateway has a stable trusted association between an agent turn and its originating UI connection.

recommendation.title: Target the initiating UI
recommendation.body: Carry or derive a trusted initiating-client target and deliver the command only to that capable Control UI, with a defined session-scoped fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The related roadmap issues and this implementation identify this person as the clearest available owner of the intended presentation-tier behavior.
